description: Find patterns by meaning, not by keyword. Uses TF-IDF + cosine similarity over the full catalogue metadata (title, tags, style, industry_fit, role, tech). Returns the top-N most semantically related patterns with a relevance score. Use this when recommend_patterns misses because the brief uses different vocabulary than the tags. FREE, no key required.

query.description: what you are looking for, in natural language

name: search_patterns
